To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

fruits and vegetables have a high nutrient and phytochemical content that can prevent and/or delay the development of several noncommunicable diseases, and they are the main source of fiber, several minerals (such as calcium, potassium, magnesium, and phosphorus), and vitamins (such as vitamin C, folate, and vitamin A) in the human diet.
Fruits and vegetables are a good source of nutrients and phytochemical substances.

fruits and vegetables are a major contributor to the diet, with a high content of nutrients and bioactive compounds, with a wide range of biological effects, and with the ability to reduce the risk of several diseases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying, isolating, and characterizing the phytochemicals that contribute to the health benefits of fruits and vegetables and the mechanisms by which they exert their biological activities.
the identification of the compounds present in fruits and vegetables and the elucidation of their mechanisms of action in order to understand the health effects of fruits and vegetables.

the development of new technologies to increase shelf-life and quality of fresh-cut fruits and vegetables, the development of functional foods and nutraceuticals from these products and the evaluation of their health-promoting properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
fruits and vegetables are essential components of a healthy diet and that their regular consumption can contribute to the prevention of several diseases.
the regular consumption of fruits, vegetables, and other foods rich in phytochemicals is a healthy choice for all populations and can help reduce the risk for chronic disease.
fruits and vegetables are a fundamental part of the diet, and their consumption should be encouraged as a preventive and therapeutic tool for many chronic diseases, including cancer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
fruits and vegetables are a rich source of nutrients and phytochemical substances that contribute to human health.
fruits and vegetables are an important source of dietary nutrients and phytochemical constituents that are able to prevent and treat several diseases.
the consumption of fruits and vegetable should be encouraged in the daily diet, and this is a key message for the general population and for those with chronic disease.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the regular consumption of fruits, vegetables, and legumes, which are the main sources of phytochemicals that are beneficial for health, should be encouraged by all governments and health authorities.
fruits and vegetables are important sources of essential nutrients and provide health benefits.
the consumption of a variety of fruits and vegetables can be a simple, cost-effective, and safe approach to prevent and control several noncommunicable diseases.
